import itertools, collections, math
# Fixed relations (i,j, pin_i,pin_j) imply t_j=t_i+p_i-p_j
fixed_edges=[('D','E',(15,3),(20,10)),('E','B',(21,15),(1,18)),('F','A',(24,19),(3,3))]
# Endpoint list from above and compatible pair candidates
edgeopts=[]
for i,j in compatible:
    ei,ej=ends[i],ends[j]
    edgeopts.append((i,j))

def solve_relations(sel):
    rels=list(fixed_edges)
    for i,j in sel:
        a,b=ends[i],ends[j]
        rels.append((a[0],b[0],a[2],b[2]))
    # adjacency stores t_v = t_u + d
    adj=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for u,v,pu,pv in rels:
        d=(pu[0]-pv[0],pu[1]-pv[1])
        adj[u].append((v,d)); adj[v].append((u,(-d[0],-d[1])))
    ts={}
    for start in pieces:
        if start in ts: continue
        ts[start]=(0,0); stack=[start]
        while stack:
            u=stack.pop()
            for v,d in adj[u]:
                val=(ts[u][0]+d[0],ts[u][1]+d[1])
                if v in ts:
                    if ts[v]!=val:return None
                else: ts[v]=val; stack.append(v)
    # connected?
    todo={'D'}; seen=set()
    while todo:
        u=todo.pop()
        if u in seen: continue
        seen.add(u); todo.update(v for v,_ in adj[u] if v not in seen)
    if len(seen)!=len(pieces): return None
    # all translations are relative to D; normalize to E=0
    d=ts['E']; ts={k:(v[0]-d[0],v[1]-d[1]) for k,v in ts.items()}
    # must match predefined intended anchor relations, e.g E=0
    # no color overlap/pin-to-color overlap
    cellmap={}; pinmap={}; bad=False
    for name,p in pieces.items():
        dr,dc=ts[name]
        for r,c in p['cells']:
            pos=(r+dr,c+dc)
            if pos in cellmap: bad=True
            cellmap[pos]=name
        for (r,c),d0 in p['pins']:
            pos=(r+dr,c+dc)
            pinmap.setdefault(pos,[]).append((name,d0))
    # ensure no pins cover colored cells; except if pin is itself? all pin cells no color in same object
    if set(cellmap)&set(pinmap): bad=True
    # bboxes
    allpos=list(cellmap)+list(pinmap)
    bbox=(min(r for r,c in allpos),max(r for r,c in allpos),min(c for r,c in allpos),max(c for r,c in allpos))
    return ts,bad,bbox, len(seen)
sols=[]
for sel in itertools.combinations(edgeopts,4):
    # endpoint disjoint
    inds=[i for e in sel for i in e]
    if len(set(inds))<8: continue
    res=solve_relations(sel)
    if res is not None:
        ts,bad,bbox,n=res
        sols.append((sel,ts,bad,bbox))
len(sols)
